title: ComplianceStatusRequestEnum
description:
* `OPTED_OUT` - Customer has opted out of the E911 service.
 * `LOCATION_SETUP` - Building and locations stage of the RedSky account creation has been completed.
 * `ALERTS` - Email notification configuration stage of the RedSky account creation has been completed.
 * `NETWORK_ELEMENTS` - Network wire map configuration stage of the RedSky account creation process has been completed and Webex Calling will begin routing emergency test number calls (933) to RedSky.
 * `ROUTING_ENABLED` - Emergency calls for devices in the specified locations will begin to route to RedSky.
